Gg.bar_b_note: The huge spider has a bold silhouette, but saturated gold covers the whole body in a busy, even wasp pattern, so it reads as a hazard-striped asset rather than a Palworld-finish storm creature.

Ql.bar_b_note: The naturalistic dark fur, pink snout and claws are on-style, but the creature barely reaches the trainer's height and its blue spine sheen never pops as storm arcs.

Wu.bar_b_note: Side B's dark navy wolf with violet arcs matches the owner's in-game Tanglevolt and carries the set; side A's washed-out violet glow would not.

Hv.bar_b_note: This is the same gold-flooded spider as Gg: strong scale and silhouette, but no dark coat for the arcs to pop against, which sinks it.

Le.bar_b_note: A warm, readable elder: the face and eyes are clean, and the earthy green-and-brown kit fits the Meadows palette, though the face is more animated-film than stylised realism.

Ns.bar_b_note: Uniform grass carpet, a pale low-poly rock and flat light sink it, even though side A's timber-and-stone wall at least reads as built.

Zr.bar_b_note: Side A's large blue-grey panel is legible, but the dark, murky rainy scene behind it has none of Palworld's saturation or Valheim's storm light.

Xh.bar_b_note: Side B's clean blue dragon with red-orange fins reads well but leans cartoon rather than the owner's naturalistic bar, and side A breaks outright in its faint frames.

top_changes.change: Rebuild the storm-creature material: a dark base coat (navy or brown) with thin, bright emissive arc lines plus bloom, replacing the full-body gold flood on the spider (Gg, Hv), the dull blue spine sheen (Ql) and the washed violet wolf (Wu A).

Keep the larger UI and build layouts: wrap recipe text in a large panel and turn the Craft/Leave hints into teal controller-glyph buttons (Zr); give the wall a timber frame, cap and stone footing, add infill depth and thickness, and tone down the pale infill (Ns).
Fix creature presentation errors: Xh A's faint-end material/model swap to tan grey and its detached shadow blob in faint mid; scale Ql so it stands clearly taller than the 1.80 m trainer.
